maya: Heads up — hotfix PR #482 needs 2x LGTM before 16:00 PT cutoff for the emergency roll (memory leak on v2 models). Can reviewers please check?

alex: on it, pinging @sam @jen — I'll try to do a quick pass now.

sam: I can review in ~30m, heads down on infra rn. If anyone else can do quick verification earlier that helps.

jen: I can look in ~15. is this the same test failure from staging?

maya: Not the staging flaky. Repro steps in PR description. Unit tests are green; failing integ is from unrelated upstream dataset timing. The code change is a small pointer fix in kv cache eviction:

```diff
- if (cache.size() > limit) cache.pop_front();
+ while (cache.size() > limit) cache.pop_front();
```

maya: TL;DR: fix avoids single-entry overflow when batches interleave. No model behavior changes.

jen: OK reading now. quick question: did you add a safety check for null ptr?

maya: yes — line 214 has `if (!entry) return;` (see PR). I added a unit that exercises null-case.

alex: I ran the patch locally and ran the unit suite + the small reproducer script. No new regressions. logs: `./scripts/repro_kv.sh --repeat 50` finished clean.

sam: just did a quick code read. Looks good functional-wise. Can we add a short comment explaining the `while` rationale to avoid future revert? small nit.

maya: will add comment and push.

deploy-bot: Reminder: emergency deploy window today 16:00 PT — cutoff for approvals 15:50 PT.

jen: added minor comment suggestion and ran `make integ-fast` against a cleaned env. integ still failing but logs show unrelated timeout on dataset fetch. Not a blocker.

jen: LGTM after the comment added. :thumbsup:

alex: LGTM as well. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks — we have 2x LGTM. I'll merge and kick the hotfix pipeline.

maya: Merged and tagged `hotfix/v2-memfix-482`. Triggering deploy.

deploy-bot: Hotfix pipeline started: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/482/hotfix (ETA ~18m).

sam: nice, thanks for moving quickly.

maya: will monitor prod logs and alert if anything odd. Thanks all. :heart:
